en.headline: Government raises 2026 GDP growth forecast to 4.8 percent
en.dek: Government Economist Irina Fan said third-quarter growth reached 5.2 percent, with the first nine months expanding 5.1 percent, the fastest pace in five years.
body: The Hong Kong government on Friday revised its full-year real GDP growth forecast for 2026 upward to 4.8 percent, from the previous range of 3.5 to 4.5 percent issued in August.

Government Economist Irina Fan said at a press conference that the economy expanded 5.2 percent year on year in the third quarter, accelerating from 4.2 percent in the second quarter. Growth in the first nine months reached 5.1 percent, the fastest pace for that period in five years.

Fan attributed the performance to robust global investment in artificial intelligence and related trade, which drove total goods exports up 30.3 percent in the third quarter. Private consumption rose 2.9 percent for a sixth consecutive quarter, while investment and employment earnings also continued to grow. The labour market remained broadly stable.

She said incoming data pointed to sustained momentum into the fourth quarter, with domestic demand expected to stay resilient. However, external uncertainties including geopolitical tensions, US monetary policy and trade protectionist measures warranted closer monitoring. Underlying and headline consumer price inflation forecasts for the year were revised down to 1.9 percent and 2.0 percent respectively.

zh.headline: 政府上調2026年全年經濟增長預測至4.8%
zh.dek: 政府經濟顧問范婉兒表示，第三季經濟增長5.2%，首三季合共增長5.1%，為五年來同期最快。
body: 香港特區政府周五將2026年全年實質本地生產總值增長預測由8月的3.5%至4.5%上調至4.8%。
政府經濟顧問范婉兒在記者會上表示，第三季經濟按年增長5.2%，較第二季的4.2%加快。首三季合共增長5.1%，為五年來同期最快步伐。
范婉兒指，全球人工智能相關投資及貿易強勁，帶動第三季整體貨物出口按年實質增長30.3%。私人消費開支連續第六季上升2.9%，投資及就業收入亦持續增長，勞工市場大致穩定。
她表示，進入第四季的數據顯示增長勢頭持續，本地需求料保持穩健。然而，外圍環境仍有不確定性，包括地緣政治緊張、美國貨幣政策及貿易保護主義措施，需要密切監察。全年基本及整體通脹率預測分別下調至1.9%及2.0%。
